result.title: RSIV-Harness: A Recursive Self-Improvement Harness Framework for Open-Domain Conversational Text-to-Visualization
result.summary: Users often request charts without knowing which database or table holds the relevant data. Such requests may be ambiguous, and users may ask follow-up questions to deepen their analysis or iteratively refine existing charts. A useful assistant must therefore discover relevant data sources among heterogeneous databases, ask clarifying questions when needed, and track evolving user intent while preserving constraints established in earlier turns. Yet recent text-to-visualization agents typically rely on static agent harnesses that are predefined and remain unchanged despite recurring failures across tasks. To address this limitation, we introduce RSIV-Harness, which keeps the language model weights fixed and applies Recursive Self-Improvement to revise the surrounding harness from the agent's own failure traces. To balance flexible self-improvement with stability, we introduce a four-layer framework that evaluates proposed harness revisions through anchor and memory checks, refining those that pass and restoring the best validated harness otherwise. We further introduce ODAC-Vis, a benchmark with 640 tasks for Open-Domain, Ambiguous, and Conversational text-to-visualization that jointly evaluates open-domain data discovery, ambiguity resolution, multi-turn visualization refinement, and executable chart generation. Experiments show that a single round of RSIV-Harness improves all six evaluation metrics relative to the seed harness, with particularly large gains in executability (+28.02 points) and chart structure (+34.01 points), demonstrating the ability to learn from task-solving experience and turn recurring failures across tasks into substantial performance improvements.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 RSIV-Harness，在冻结语言模型权重的前提下，用智能体自身的失败轨迹递归修订外围 harness，并以 anchor 与 memory 校验筛选修订、不通过时回退已验证最佳版本；同时给出 640 个任务的 ODAC-Vis 基准，评测开放域数据发现、歧义澄清与多轮图表改进。
AI.relevance_reason: 「失败轨迹驱动修订＋校验/回退」这一稳定化机制可能为 LVR 中训练期监督、候选状态验证与何时追问/停止的决策提供线索，但论文本身面向 text-to-visualization 智能体，不涉及视觉潜在状态，需人工核查其可迁移性。
